grounded_vs_unmapped_summary.note: Unlike Finance (which carried FRAUD_SCANDAL = an information-integrity/deception failure with NO analog among the 9 E/I-dynamics classes, marked UNMAPPED), the Economy issue set contains no fabricated-signal/deception archetype. Every Economy issue is a macro E/I-dynamics failure (runaway, gating-lock, brake-loss, or spreading hypoactivity) and maps to one of the 9 Part XIV classes. TRADE_WAR carries a partial adversarial/strategic (game-theoretic retaliation) layer the pure E/I taxonomy only partly captures; its dominant circuit mechanism is still dynamical and is mapped, with the residue flagged (not force-fit, not fully unmapped).

heterogeneity_flagged: RECESSION — THE KEY ECONOMY FINDING. It is the ONLY issue (across Energy 6/6, Finance 6/6, Economy 5/6) whose _authored circuit FAILS the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test: its five authored nodes (M1, S1, NAcc, STRI, VTA) are all bare excitatory/driver/sensory nodes and NONE belongs to the REGULATORY_NODES set (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM). The circuit is authored with no inhibitory/feedback/brake partner at all — it is lesioned in exactly the way Part XIV describes. Its canonical single-node circuit (NAcc[Hypo] 'avolition') is ALSO a bare non-regulatory node, so RECESSION is incomplete under BOTH the canonical and the authored circuit.

RECESSION failure-class = CORTICAL_SPREADING_DEPRESSION. Economy is the first of the three domains to use the HYPOACTIVITY / silence pole of the taxonomy. Energy and Finance mapped their issues to runaway/gating/brake-loss (the over-active pole); Economy's RECESSION is generalized under-drive that spreads across sectors ('depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm'), and MARKET_CRASH/HYPERINFLATION cover the over-active pole. The domain therefore exercises both poles of the E/I taxonomy.

TRADE_WAR — node-cue vs class divergence, plus an adversarial residue. Classed SEIZURE on the escalating-retaliatory-runaway mechanism ('Escalating cycle of retaliatory tariffs'), but its canonical NODE cue ('conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong') points at a predictive-coding / salience miscalibration (over-strong priors), a flavor the 9 dynamical classes do not cleanly hold — the same node-vs-summary divergence Finance flagged on SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION. The deliberate game-theoretic retaliation layer is adversarial and only partly representable in the E/I taxonomy; it is flagged, not resolved by guessing.

Canonical circuits are 'healthier' than Finance's. Four of the six Economy canonical single-node circuits are themselves REGULATORY_NODES (HYPERINFLATION=HYPO, BANKING_CRISIS=GP, TRADE_WAR=dACC, DEBT_CRISIS=STN), so they pass the incomplete-circuit test even canonical-only. Only RECESSION (NAcc) and MARKET_CRASH (BLA) have bare canonical nodes; of those two, MARKET_CRASH is rescued by its _authored circuit while RECESSION is not.
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Economy-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

RECESSION.subtype: spreading contraction/silence -> homeostatic overwhelm (the hypoactivity pole)
RECESSION.economy_text: canonical circuit NAcc[Hypo]: "incentive/reward drive — avolition"; _authored circuit is UNIFORMLY hypo-active (M1 Hypo 'GDP output contracting', S1 Hypo 'Labor markets seizing up', NAcc Hypo 'Consumer spending retreating', STRI Hypo 'Industrial production declining', VTA Hypo 'Entrepreneurial activity suppressed'); summary: "Sustained contraction in economic output... often triggering cascading effects across sectors"
RECESSION.reasoning: Every authored node is DOWN (avolition, contraction, seizing up, declining, suppressed) and the summary describes the contraction propagating 'across sectors'. That is the CORTICAL_SPREADING_DEPRESSION archetype: a wave of reduced activity then silence, a homeostatic overwhelm as aggregate demand falls below potential. This is the taxonomy's HYPOACTIVITY/silence pole, which neither Energy nor Finance exercised.
RECESSION.note: The 'cascading effects across sectors' clause straddles DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS (loss of demand-input to one sector disabling connected sectors). Classed on the dominant mechanism cue — generalized hypoactivity/avolition/silence (CSD) — with the cascade straddle recorded, not resolved by guessing. SEPARATELY: RECESSION is the one issue that FAILS the incomplete-circuit test (see incomplete_circuit_diagnostic); the two diagnostics agree here — a brake-free, all-hypo circuit is exactly the lesioned mapping.

HYPERINFLATION.subtype: runaway from a severed homeostatic set-point (recurrent price-wage spiral)
HYPERINFLATION.economy_text: canonical circuit HYPO[Hyper]: "homeostatic set-point — severed=runaway"; _authored HYPO Hyper 'Price-level homeostasis completely broken with exponential increases'; summary: "Extreme and accelerating price increases destroying the purchasing power of currency"
HYPERINFLATION.reasoning: The cue names the homeostatic set-point SEVERED -> runaway, and the summary names an exponential/accelerating (recurrent, self-reinforcing) price spiral. Runaway recurrent excitation once the load-bearing negative-feedback brake is gone is the SEIZURE archetype (no-brakes -> runaway).
HYPERINFLATION.note: Straddles DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (the severed HYPO set-point is a lost regulator). Classed SEIZURE on the 'exponential/accelerating runaway' recurrent-spiral outcome the summary emphasizes; the lost-regulator flavor is the DISINHIBITION straddle.

BANKING_CRISIS.economy_text: canonical circuit GP[Hypo]: "basal-ganglia output gate — lock (bradykinetic freeze)"; summary: "Systemic failure in the banking sector... threatening the payment system and credit intermediation functions essential to economic activity"; _authored dlPFC Hypo 'institutions hoard cash and refuse to lend', THAL Hypo 'Monetary policy transmission completely blocked'
BANKING_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is an OUTPUT GATE locked (bradykinetic freeze); the authored circuit describes credit intermediation and monetary transmission blocked, starving the real economy of credit. A gate stuck closed producing downstream starvation is the GATING_FAILURE archetype (gate stuck closed -> starvation) — the identical mapping made for Finance BANKING_CRISIS.
BANKING_CRISIS.note: Same canonical node (GP output-gate lock) and same class as the Finance BANKING_CRISIS issue: a clean cross-domain isomorphism on the gating-lock archetype.

TRADE_WAR.economy_text: canonical circuit dACC[Hyper]: "conflict/error monitor — priors-too-strong"; summary: "Escalating cycle of retaliatory tariffs, sanctions, and trade barriers between major economies"; _authored TPJ Hypo 'Perspective-taking between trading partners collapsed', dACC Hyper 'Regulatory complexity exploding'
TRADE_WAR.reasoning: An escalating retaliatory cycle (tariff -> counter-tariff -> counter-counter-tariff) is recurrent positive feedback with no damping brake, i.e. the SEIZURE archetype (runaway recurrent excitation). The dACC[Hyper] conflict-monitor over-firing supplies the driver; TPJ[Hypo] (collapsed perspective-taking) is the lost damping.
TRADE_WAR.note: TWO caveats recorded, not force-fit: (1) node-cue divergence — the canonical cue 'priors-too-strong' is a predictive-coding / salience miscalibration (over-weighted priors) that the 9 dynamical classes do not cleanly hold (same node-vs-summary divergence Finance flagged on SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION); (2) the retaliatory dynamic is partly adversarial/game-theoretic (deliberate policy), a strategic layer the pure E/I taxonomy only partially represents. The dominant mechanism (escalating runaway) is dynamical and mappable, so SEIZURE stands with the residue flagged. Also straddles OSCILLATORY_PATHOLOGY if read as two economies locked in a pathological over-coupled escalation.

DEBT_CRISIS.subtype: brake-fail -> runaway accumulation (loss of the stop/hold)
DEBT_CRISIS.economy_text: canonical circuit STN[Hypo]: "hyperdirect brake / hold — no-brake=runaway"; summary: "Unsustainable accumulation of sovereign or corporate debt threatening default... potentially triggering contagion across interconnected financial systems"; _authored vmPFC Hypo 'Fiscal policy space exhausted'
DEBT_CRISIS.reasoning: The named mechanism is explicitly the loss of the STN hyperdirect BRAKE/HOLD ('no-brake=runaway'). Losing the inhibitor and releasing runaway (unsustainable) accumulation is the exact DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Strongest grounding of the set — mirrors Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE (vmPFC 'brake-fail=rogue').
DEBT_CRISIS.note: Summary's 'contagion across interconnected financial systems' straddles DEAFFERENTATION_DIASCHISIS (cross-graph cascade). Classed on the PRIMARY node cue 'no-brake=runaway' -> DISINHIBITION; the contagion clause is the straddle.

MARKET_CRASH.economy_text: canonical circuit BLA[Hyper]: "threat learning/acquisition — over-fear=PTSD"; _authored BLA Hyper 'Fear contagion amplifying sell-offs as loss aversion and margin calls create self-reinforcing downward spirals'; summary: "Sudden and severe decline in asset prices... destroying wealth, triggering margin calls"
MARKET_CRASH.reasoning: Over-fear (excessive threat drive) plus explicitly 'self-reinforcing downward spirals' from margin calls is recurrent runaway exceeding insufficient damping = the SEIZURE archetype (no-brakes -> runaway). Identical to Finance MARKET_CRASH.
MARKET_CRASH.note: Straddles DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME (PTSD = failed extinction/brake). Classed SEIZURE on the 'self-reinforcing spiral' runaway the _authored text names — the same call the Finance overlay made for its MARKET_CRASH issue. Canonical node BLA[Hyper] is a bare non-regulatory node that would fail the incomplete-circuit test canonical-only; the _authored circuit (OFC/HIPP/dACC) supplies the brakes so the test passes on _authored.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against economy.json _authored circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior (uses _authored node list; falls back to circuits if _authored absent — all 6 Economy issues have _authored).
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: PASS 5/6, FAIL 1. RECESSION is INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT — its authored nodes (M1, S1, NAcc, STRI, VTA) contain NO regulatory/feedback partner; it is a brake-free, uniformly-hypo circuit, lesioned exactly as Part XIV describes. The other five all include at least one regulatory node. This is the FIRST incomplete-circuit failure across the three domains audited (Energy 6/6 complete, Finance 6/6 complete, Economy 5/6). NOTE ALSO: two issues (RECESSION, MARKET_CRASH) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (NAcc, BLA) that are bare non-regulatory nodes; MARKET_CRASH is rescued by its _authored circuit, RECESSION is not.

RECESSION.observation: FAILS. Five bare driver/sensory/reward nodes, none in REGULATORY_NODES. The canonical single-node circuit NAcc[Hypo] 'avolition' is ALSO non-regulatory, so RECESSION is incomplete under BOTH canonical and _authored. This is the domain's key structural finding: the recession circuit was authored with no inhibitory/feedback/stabilizer arm — matching its CORTICAL_SPREADING_DEPRESSION (no-brake, spreading-silence) failure class.

HYPERINFLATION.observation: Canonical single-node circuit HYPO[Hyper] is itself a REGULATORY_NODE (homeostatic set-point), so this issue passes even canonical-only.

BANKING_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit GP[Hypo] is itself a REGULATORY_NODE (basal-ganglia output gate), so this issue passes even canonical-only.

TRADE_WAR.observation: Canonical single-node circuit dACC[Hyper] is itself a REGULATORY_NODE (conflict monitor), so this issue passes even canonical-only.

DEBT_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit STN[Hypo] is itself a REGULATORY_NODE (hyperdirect brake), so this issue passes even canonical-only.

MARKET_CRASH.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is BLA[Hyper] alone (threat-acquisition node, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies OFC/HIPP/dACC brakes.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Economy mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation (e.g. market/price ticks vs. monetary-and-fiscal-policy lags), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
